name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies VR
summary:
The hit Ace Attorney series finally comes to the immersive world of VR!
Take on the roles of Phoenix Wright, Apollo Justice, and Athena Cykes—and prove your clients innocent of all charges!

After 8 long years, Phoenix Wright makes his return as a lawyer in this 5th mainline game.
The story starts with a bang in the middle of a badly-damaged courtroom.
Along with Apollo Justice and Athena Cykes, Phoenix works to bring an end to the current “Dark Age of the Law”, where the pursuit of victory trumps the pursuit of the truth.
